verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe this story almost word for word. After an external meeting it automatically drafts a follow-up email using the transcript, calendar and past Gmail threads 'so you can send it in a couple of clicks' [granola-docs-45]. Granola Chat can also 'draft and send a follow-up email' on request [granola-docs-5, granola-docs-29]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the drafts are good enough to send with minimal edits.
